contexts: Health region with four hospitals and about 90 practices
34 percent of sampled lumbar MRI requests without an indication
reading: The procurement question sits on a crowded, overlapping and often low-quality review literature. Effects on appropriateness and orders are consistent in direction but come from uncontrolled studies that reviews count repeatedly. Override behaviour and alert design decide whether a tool works in practice, and equity effects are almost unreported. The famous 40 percent figure is an unverified lead.
